The dancer wears a floral wreath, a white blouse with embroidered sleeves, and a blue patterned bodice over a long green skirt. Colorful ribbons (red, yellow, green) extend from the top of the frame downwards, indicating the presence of the maypole just out of view or partially obscured. In the background, other participants and spectators are visible on a grassy field with trees.
